description_en: Queries the diagnostic information about a Spark application
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-spark-app-diagnosis-info --db-cluster-id amv-uf663j39b0jd2000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --app-id s202411061017sh0ad564b0000000 --biz-language zh --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSparkAppDiagnosisInfo

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters within a region, including cluster IDs
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html接口查看目标地域下所有的集群信息，包括集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html接口查看AnalyticDB MySQL版支持的地域和可用区信息，包括地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The application ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/455888.html operation to query all application IDs
parameters.help_zh:
应用ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/455888.html接口查询所有的应用ID
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en:

en: English.
zh (default): Chinese
